unit_note: Family match counts overlap. Windows are reviewed episodes, including collapsed series, not exact counts of attacks or independent games. Classifications are semantic review annotations; aggregation is deterministic.

W.definition: Warrior attack before a substantive Paladin commitment

P.definition: Paladin damage commitment following Warrior pressure

R.definition: Return to Warrior after a substantive Paladin commitment

I.definition: Paladin recommit after a recorded protection response

B.definition: Renewed Paladin attack without a newly established protection interval

W.definition: Enemy Rogue attack before a substantive Priest commitment

P.definition: Enemy Priest commitment following Rogue pressure

R.definition: Return to enemy Rogue after Priest damage commitment
